title: BioMate Pipeline Output Manifest
description: Written by every completed BioMate Nextflow pipeline. Describes what the pipeline produced and where each named output port can be found.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Increment when port structure changes.

pipeline_id.description: Must match a key in pipeline_registry.json.

invocation_id.description: BioMate invocation ID assigned at workflow launch. Used by the manifest resolver API.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of pipeline completion.

outdir.description: Absolute path to the output directory. All port paths are relative to this.

pipeline_version.description: Git commit SHA or semver tag of the pipeline at runtime. Optional but recommended.

params.description: Key acquisition and processing parameters used in this run. Not exhaustive — only parameters relevant for downstream interpretation.

metrics.description: Key scientific metrics from the run. Pipeline-specific.

ports.description: Named output ports. Keys must match the pipeline's declared output port names in pipeline_registry.json. Values are paths relative to outdir.

additionalProperties.description: Relative path from outdir to the output file.

upstream_invocation_ids.description: Invocation IDs of pipelines whose outputs were used as inputs to this run. Enables dependency graph reconstruction.
